Handover summary

The heading above is never closed, and neither is this paragraph. Hand-written HTML does this constantly and browsers recover silently, so discovery has to as well.

A block element opened inside another, with neither closed.

And a second one nested inside the first, to make sure recovery does not simply take the outermost element and treat everything as one region.

A paragraph after all of that, still unclosed, with enough text in it to be a realistic edit target rather than a stub.

  • A list item that is never closed
  • Followed by another one
  • And a third, with the list itself left open at the end of the document
